#!/bin/bash
#SBATCH --job-name=memworkers
#SBATCH --nodes=1
#SBATCH --ntasks=1
#SBATCH --time=00:15:00
#SBATCH --mem=512M

# --mem is the allocation for the whole node, so four resident workers need four
# times one worker's footprint. Each worker also pays for its 32MB twice, once in
# the pipe and once in the variable, which is why 128MB of data asks for 512M.
pids=()
for i in 1 2 3 4; do
  (
    chunk=$(head -c 33554432 /dev/zero | tr '\0' 'x')
    [ "${#chunk}" -eq 33554432 ]
  ) &
  pids+=("$!")
done

completed=0
for p in "${pids[@]}"; do
  if wait "$p"; then completed=$((completed + 1)); fi
done

echo "WORKERS=${completed}"
echo ANVIL_OK
